newsitem.title: UK: UK Estates advises on Ashquay offer.
newsitem.headline: UK Estates advises on Ashquay offer.

text.p: British property development firm UK Estates Plc said on Friday it had written to its shareholders advising them not to respond to offers made by Ashquay Group .
"The board of UK Estates notes the unsolicited offers from Ashquay and urges you to take no action in response to the offers," a company statment quoted UK Estates as telling its shareholders.
In its letter UK Estates emphasised that Ashquay's net assets as of September 30, 1996 stood at 7.9 million stg compared to its 18.5 million stg.

Ashquay, which has only been deeply involved in property since it made an acquisition in January this year, is offering 10 offer shares for every 13 UK Estate ordinary shares, valuing the target company at 21.1 million stg.
UK Estates traded in the 27-29 p range before closing at 27 p on Friday. Ashquay closed at 41 1/2 p.
"...Your board believes that the form of the offers is not an acceptable way to convey the value of the company to you", it said.
UK Estates said it would respond more to the offer document in due course.
